tagline: Control the TV from your phone
g_desc: Move your ball and score in the hoop on the far side. Go in gently: a fast ball bounces off. 90 seconds.
g_hint: Red scores on the right and blue on the left. A goal within 5 seconds is worth 3 points, within 10 seconds 2 points, after that 1 point. If no second player joins, the computer plays instead.
h_desc: Move the mallet with your finger and hit the puck into the other goal. First to 7 goals wins.
h_hint: Red plays on the left and black on the right. If no second player joins, the computer plays instead.
j_desc: Eat to grow. Do not hit yourself or the other snake. Leave one edge of the screen and you come back from the opposite one. 90 seconds, the longest snake wins.
j_hint: A red pellet is 1 point and a golden one is 3. You can put your own face on the snake with the ⚙️ button inside the game.
draw_hint: Every phone draws with its own colour and tools at the same time. “Undo” removes only your own last stroke. “Enlarge canvas” fills the phone screen; turn the phone sideways for calligraphy.
laser_tilt: Move the pointer by tilting the phone
laser_hint: The pointer disappears by itself after 4 seconds and uses your pen colour. The spotlight dims the screen and leaves one clear circle.
mic_lock: Lock the microphone (tap to start, tap to stop)
mic_hint: Your voice comes out of the TV speakers. Keep the phone away from the TV to avoid echo.
mic_secure: The browser allows the microphone only on the secure link. Open it, and when the “connection is not private” warning appears choose “Advanced”, then “Proceed”.
pic_pick: 📷 Choose a picture and show it
home_title: 📲 Put Lamma on your home screen
home_why: One tap opens it like an app, with no address to type.
home_a1: Open the browser menu ⋮ at the top.
home_a3: Tap Add. The Lamma icon appears next to your apps.
home_i1: Open this page in Safari and tap the share button ⬆️.
home_i2: Scroll and tap Add to Home Screen.
home_i3: Tap Add. The Lamma icon appears next to your apps.
home_note: If the TV's address changes, the icon stops opening. Give the TV a fixed address in your router to avoid that.
al_daily: Every day at a set time:
ch_ph: New chore, like: tidy your room
ch_empty: No chores yet. Add the first one below.
ch_hint: A finished chore adds its points to the family board and the TV celebrates. Chores open again every day.
ch_need_name: Write your name at the top first, so the points go to you.
ch_undo_ask: Take this chore back as not done? Its points are removed.
z_desc: One question on the TV for everybody. Answer on your phone: the faster you are right, the more points you get.
z_hint: Spelling: the TV says an English word and you type it. Right answers add points to the family board.
z_say: Say the word on my phone too
z_wait: {0} players are in. Press Start when everyone has joined.
z_q_flag: Look at the TV: which country has this flag?
z_sent: Answer sent ✓ Waiting for the others
z_time: Time is up. The answer is
m_desc: A workout on the beat. Moves run towards you on the TV: step left, step right, jump or duck when they reach the gold line.
m_hint: Hold the phone in your hand and move it with your body. Open the page from the secure link so the motion sensor works; the four buttons do the same by touch.
m_swap: Left and right are still swapped: fix it
m_wait: Try a move: the figure on the TV copies you. Then press Start
m_no_motion: No motion sensor here. Open the secure link, or use the buttons below.
m_sensor_on: 🟢 Motion sensor is working: move the phone
m_sensor_off: 🔴 No signal from the motion sensor: use the buttons
m_sensor_link: 🔴 Open the secure link (https) for the motion sensor
m_sensor_unused: Motion sensor is off: use the buttons
m_cal: 🎯 Set up the sensor (how you hold the phone)
m_cal1: Stand still, holding the phone the way you will play…
m_cal2: Now take one step to the RIGHT 👉
m_cal_fail: No step was felt. Try again, a little stronger.
hz_desc: Learn the Quran by heart: listen and repeat while the words hide one by one, recite from memory, and revise each part on the right day.
hz_juz_hint: Tap the juz your child knows. Today's portion is taken from them.
hz_credit: Quran text: Tanzil Project (tanzil.net). Recitation: Mahmoud Khalil Al-Husary, from EveryAyah.com. The TV needs the internet for the recitation.
hz_auto: Play on by itself, with time to repeat
hz_ask_listen: This part is new. Listen and repeat first? (Cancel = recite from memory)
hz_no_juz: Choose the memorised juz below to get a daily portion.
hz_all_done: Nothing is due today. Well done!
hz_parent: follow the text and mark each ayah
hz_chal_hint: Questions on the TV: which ayah comes next, and how an ayah goes on. Answer alone, or let others join with their names and press Start. Every choice is real Quran text.
hz_local: Play the recitation from this phone, not the TV
hz_tv_fail: The TV could not play the recitation. Check its internet, or tick the box above to hear it from this phone.
hz_local_fail: This phone could not play the recitation. Check the internet.
hz_mic: 🎙️ Follow by microphone: each word is written on the TV when it is recited right
hz_mic_note: Keep the phone close to the reciter. The browser sends the speech to Google or Apple to be recognised, so the phone needs the internet. It catches a wrong or forgotten word, not vowel marks or tajweed.
hz_mic_browser: Following by microphone works in Chrome or Safari. In this browser a grown-up marks the recitation instead.
hz_mic_secure: Following by microphone needs the secure link. Open it, and when the “connection is not private” warning appears choose “Advanced”, then “Proceed”.
hz_mic_off: 🎙️ Tap to turn the microphone on
hz_mic_net: Speech recognition did not work. Check the internet on this phone.
hz_heard_wrong: ✗ Not right. Say the right word again. Heard: {0}
hz_help: For a grown-up: “Show the word” counts as a mistake. “It was right” is for when the microphone misheard.
prank_sound: Prank sounds (breaking glass and fly buzz)
prank_hint: “Cracked screen”: every tap adds more cracks. “Insect”: one tap brings it, a second tap sends it away; pick its kind and size below. “Lion” takes 7 seconds: a black frame closes on the screen, the lion runs in from far away and jumps out of the frame.
prayer_on: Show the alert on the TV
prayer_at: Second alert when the prayer time starts
prayer_try: Try the alert on the TV
show_qr: Show the QR code on the TV
qr_hint: The QR code lets anyone on the same Wi-Fi open this page on their phone.
prayer_adhan: Sound the call to prayer when the time starts
prayer_adhan_wait: The TV is still saving the recording of the call to prayer (it needs the internet the first time). Until then a chime plays instead.
prayer_boot: Open the Lamma home screen when the TV starts
tvhome_up: 🖼 Send a photo from your phone
tvhome_sent: Done, the photo is now behind the home screen.
tvhome_fail: That photo did not work, try another one.
tvhome_clock_now: The Lamma screen shows {0} now. If that is wrong, change the choice above.
hz_ease_h0: A word must be heard exactly as it is.
hz_ease_h1: Forgives letters that sound alike (the heavy letters and their light twins).
hz_ease_h2: Forgives one wrong letter in a long word, and after 3 tries it writes the word and goes on (counted as a mistake). A look-alike word may slip through.
rc_note: The arrows and OK work on Lamma's own screens (the home screen, surahs, adhkar). 🏠 brings you back to the Lamma screen from any app.
rc_acc_off: To go back inside other apps (YouTube, say), switch on "Lamma remote" in the TV settings, under Accessibility.
rc_acc_on: "Lamma remote" is on: Back works in every app. The arrows inside other apps need Android 13 or later.
rc_acc_full: "Lamma remote" is on: the remote works in every app.
rec_desc: Records everything the TV shows for up to 3 minutes, then you download the video to your phone. No sound.
rec_ask: A question appeared on the TV: accept it with the TV's own remote to start recording.
r_desc: Everyone chooses in secret on their phone and the TV shows all hands together. Beat more hands, earn more points; alone, you play the TV.
r_alone: You are alone: you will play the TV. Press Start.
x_desc: A big letter on the TV with a word and a picture: A apple, B ball… then a game: which letter does the word start with?
st_desc: A news or weather bulletin that looks real: the phone camera films the presenter and the TV stands them in front of a moving backdrop, with a news ticker and their name.
st_loading: Getting the smart cut-out ready… (the first time takes a moment)
st_air: On air! Stand the presenter where the camera sees their whole body.
st_no_ai: The smart cut-out did not work on this phone, so the whole picture is shown. Try "green screen".
st_send: ✔ Update the texts on the TV
st_where: Where the presenter stands, and how big
st_tips: The TV shows the person only, their whole body, and nothing else in the room. For the best result: stand the phone upright on something steady, far enough to see the presenter from head to feet, and light them from the front and not from behind. The weather cards show the real forecast for your city. To record it, use "Record the TV screen" in the remote tab.
st_fit: ⚠️ Part of the body is outside the picture: move the phone back and stand it upright until it sees them from head to feet.
st_nobody: Nobody is in front of the camera. The TV shows the person only.
tilt_control: Steer by tilting the phone instead of your finger
stick_hint: Put your finger anywhere here and move it
stick_hint_g: The stick appears under your finger
h_opt_hint: The white box is your half of the table as you see it on the TV, and the red line is the centre line.
face_hint: Drag and zoom the picture until your face is inside the circle.
stick_hint_j: The snake turns that way and keeps moving
mic_unavailable: The microphone is not available on this device.
mic_denied: Could not open the microphone: allow this site to use it and try again.
mic_live: 🔴 You are live on the TV…
snd_err: ❌ The TV could not play sound.
snd_muted: ⚠️ The TV box volume is at zero or muted.
snd_ok: ✅ The TV box played the sound. If you did not hear it, turn the TV volume up and try from the home screen.
voice_got: The TV received {0} seconds of audio
pic_done: The picture is on the TV ✓
prayer_times: Today's times ({0}): {1}. The TV clock now shows {2}; if that is wrong, fix the time and time zone in the TV box settings.
clear_confirm: Clear all drawings from the TV, for everyone?
no_motion_play: The browser gave no motion data. Open the secure (https) link from the microphone section, or play with your finger.
color_taken: Another player already has this colour, try the other one.
face_done: Your face is on the snake ✓
face_failed: The picture was not sent, try again.
no_motion_laser: The browser gave no motion data. Open the secure (https) link from the microphone section, or move the pointer by touch.
voice_not_played: (but the TV has not played it yet)
cam_hint: Your phone camera appears in a corner of the TV, like a reporter at home. Your name from the comments box is shown under the picture. One phone can be live at a time.
cam_secure: The browser allows the camera only on the secure link. Open it, and when the “connection is not private” warning appears choose “Advanced”, then “Proceed”.
cam_denied: Could not open the camera: allow this site to use it and try again.
cam_busy: Another phone is live right now. Try again when it stops.
cam_on: 🔴 Live on the TV • {0} frames sent
vol_fixed: This device has a fixed volume: use the TV remote instead.
k_desc: Two teams pull a rope by solving sums on their phones. Every correct answer pulls the rope your way; harder sums pull harder.
k_hint: A wrong answer freezes your screen for a few seconds and lets the rope slip. Five correct answers in a row double your pull for 5 seconds. If one team is empty, the computer plays for it. Your name comes from the comments box.
k_opt_hint: Easy: adding and subtracting, 1 point. Medium: multiplying and dividing, 2 points. Hard: two steps, 3 or 4 points. The level and time can be changed before the round starts.
k_streak: 🔥 {0} in a row ({1} doubles your pull)
k_full: The game is full: 6 players are already in.
q_desc: An English word appears on your phone: pick its Arabic meaning. Every correct answer pushes your rocket towards the planet. Quick answers and streaks push harder.
q_next_rocket: {0} more words unlock the next rocket
q_say: Say each word aloud on my phone
q_turbo: 🔥 Turbo ready: the next answer counts double!
q_gold: ☄️ Golden meteor: answer fast for double!
f_board_hint: Write your name in the comments box, then play: 2 points for every game, 10 more for a win, and 1 for every correct answer in the math and word games. The week starts fresh every week.
f_board_empty: Nobody is on the board yet.
f_q_ph: The question, e.g. What shall we eat?
f_vote_start: Start the vote on the TV
f_vote_need: Write a question and at least two choices.
f_vote_open: {0} votes so far. Tap a choice to vote; you can change it.
f_vote_end: End the vote and show the result
f_timer_hint: Pick a time to start. A small countdown stays in the corner of the TV, and a big alert with a chime appears when it ends.
fl_desc: A 3D flight simulator on the TV: an airliner over the real Amman, with the phone as the stick.
fl_kg: Google Map Tiles key (for Amman's 3D buildings)
fl_ksave: Save the keys on the TV
fl_keys_h: Without a key you fly over satellite pictures and real terrain, but with no 3D buildings. The real buildings need a Map Tiles API key from Google Cloud (it needs a billing account), or a free token from cesium.com/ion. The key is kept on the TV only. To remove the keys, press save with both boxes empty.
fl_k_g: ✅ Google key saved: Amman's buildings in 3D.
fl_k_none: No map key: satellite pictures without 3D buildings.
fl_h_stick: Move the stick: right and left to turn, up to climb
fl_h_tilt: Tilt the phone like a wheel, and raise its far edge to climb
fl_e_nogl: This TV cannot draw 3D, so the simulator does not run on it.
fl_e_noweb: The TV has no system web view, so the simulator does not run on it.
fl_e_start: The flight screen could not be opened on the TV.
fl_e_render: 3D drawing stopped on the TV. Try the "light" quality.
fl_e_nolib: The simulator's files did not load on the TV.
